name: NanoCarrier Co., Ltd.
summary: NanoCarrier Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells pharmaceutical products using micellar nanoparticle technology primarily for the treatment of cancer in Japan. Its product pipeline includes NC-6004 Cisplatin micelle for the treatment of pancreatic, head and neck, non-small cell lung, bladder, and biliary track cancers; and VB-111, a non-replicating Adeno 5 vector for the treatment of rGBM/ovarian cancer, etc. The company's product pipeline also comprise NC-6300 Epirubicin micelle for soft tissue sarcoma; NC-4016 Dach-platinum micelle for solid cancers; and NK105 Paclitaxel micella for the treatment of breast and gastric cancers. NanoCarrier Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Kashiwa, Japan.
